exercise__records_help_intro: Only ticked working, drop and failure sets count. Warm-ups are shown in history but excluded from all numbers. Records are recomputed when sessions are edited or deleted. Dates show the first session to achieve each best.
exercise__help_weight: The greatest effective weight in a counted set. Weighted exercises use logged weight; bodyweight exercises use your bodyweight, minus assistance where applicable, with a minimum of zero. For weighted bodyweight exercises this is the greatest added load.
exercise__help_one_rm: Estimated one-rep maximum using Brzycki: effective weight × 36 ÷ (37 − reps). When you log effort, the reps you left in reserve count as reps. Only sets of 1–12 reps qualify.
exercise__records_effort_note: Estimated 1RM now counts the reps you left in reserve when you log effort, so some of these numbers moved.
exercise__help_set_volume: The greatest effective weight × reps in one counted set.
exercise__help_session_volume: The greatest sum of effective weight × reps for this exercise in one session.
exercise__help_duration: The longest duration in one counted set.
exercise__help_distance: The longest distance in one counted set.
exercise__help_pace: The fastest pace in one counted set, in minutes per kilometre. Lower is faster.
exercise__help_reps: The greatest effective weight lifted for each rep count from 1 to 12.

import__formats: Strong (Settings, Export Strong Data) and Hevy (Profile, Settings, Export & Import Data) exports work.
import__unit_assumed: This unit applies only to weights without a unit in the file.
import__unmatched_hint_one: These names are not in your library yet. {{count}} other exercise was matched by name. Tap one to choose what happens to it.
import__unmatched_hint_other: These names are not in your library yet. {{count}} other exercises were matched by name. Tap one to choose what happens to it.
import__all_matched_one: {{count}} exercise matched your library by name.
import__all_matched_other: All {{count}} exercises matched your library by name.
import__skipped_other_one: {{count}} workout has no usable sets or is outside the supported date range, so it is left out.
import__skipped_other_other: {{count}} workouts have no usable sets or are outside the supported date range, so they are left out.
import__unreadable_rows_one: {{count}} row could not be read and is left out.
import__unreadable_rows_other: {{count}} rows could not be read and are left out.
import__receipt_other_skipped_one: {{count}} more workout was left out: no usable sets or an unsupported date.
import__receipt_other_skipped_other: {{count}} more workouts were left out: no usable sets or an unsupported date.
import__undo_body_one: Undo keeps the {{count}} workout if its exercise, set, or photo list changed. Custom exercises created during import stay in your library.
import__undo_body_other: Undo keeps any of the {{count}} workouts whose exercise, set, or photo list changed. Custom exercises created during import stay in your library.
import__error_unreadable: That file could not be read.
import__error_format: That is not a Strong or Hevy export. Choose the CSV file from the app's export.
import__error_invalid_rows: No workouts could be read. Check the dates and exercise names in the export.
import__error_empty: The file has no workouts in it.
import__error_import: The import stopped. Workouts already written are kept; you can undo them from the Last import card.
import__error_undo: The undo stopped. Open this page and try again.
import__source_zone_hint: Use the time zone where you logged the workouts, such as America/New_York.
import__source_zone_invalid: Enter a valid time zone, such as Europe/London.
import__date_order: Ambiguous dates in the source file
import__dst_gap_one: {{count}} workout falls in a clock change gap and will be skipped.
import__dst_gap_other: {{count}} workouts fall in a clock change gap and will be skipped.
import__dst_overlap_one: {{count}} workout uses a repeated local time. The earlier occurrence is used.
import__dst_overlap_other: {{count}} workouts use repeated local times. The earlier occurrences are used.
import__error_csv_syntax: This CSV has invalid quoting or characters. Export a new copy and try again.
import__error_csv_limit: The CSV exceeds a limit of 20 MB, 100,000 rows, 128 columns, or 16,384 characters in one field.
import__oversized_one: {{count}} workout exceeds the sync transaction limit and is skipped. A workout must sync in one piece.
import__oversized_other: {{count}} workouts exceed the sync transaction limit and are skipped. Each workout must sync in one piece.
import__omitted_sets_one: {{count}} set was left out because it was invalid, skipped, or over a limit.
import__omitted_sets_other: {{count}} sets were left out because they were invalid, skipped, or over a limit.
import__omitted_exercises_one: {{count}} exercise entry was left out because it had no usable sets, was skipped, or was over a limit.
import__omitted_exercises_other: {{count}} exercise entries were left out because they had no usable sets, were skipped, or were over a limit.
import__partial: The import stopped before the last batch. This receipt covers the workouts already saved.
import__undo_legacy: This older import did not record its original sets and exercises, so it cannot be undone safely.
import__undo_pending: Undo is queued. Workouts will disappear after the deletes sync.
import__undo_kept_one: {{count}} workout remains. It may have changed or its undo may have been interrupted.
import__undo_kept_other: {{count}} workouts remain. They may have changed or their undo may have been interrupted.
onboarding__experience_title: How long have you been lifting?
onboarding__experience_body: This sets how many warm-up sets we suggest. Your programs are never changed. You can change it any time in Settings.
onboarding__days_body: Your weekly goal on Home. Pick the day your week starts too.
onboarding__place_body: This picks the bars and plates the plate calculator starts with. You can change it any time in Settings.
settings__experience_hint: Sets the warm-up ramp. Your own warm-up steps and your programs stay as they are.
settings__place_hint: Chooses the bars and plates a new account starts with. Equipment and programs you already set up stay as they are.
home__this_week_compare: Changes are against this time last week.
home__stalled_body: Open it to see the numbers and try a lighter load.
muscles__row_avg_label: Average {{sets}} sets a week over the last four weeks
muscles__row_hint: Opens the last eight weeks and the goal
phase__pattern_body: Weeks repeat in this order. Tap one to change it.
phase__pattern_empty: Every week is Build. Add a week to set your pattern.
phase__pattern_week_hint: Change this week or take it out
phase__pattern_week_body: Change this week of the pattern, or take it out.
phase__pattern_add_label: Add a week to the pattern
phase__strip_body: Tap a week to change only that week.
phase__push_hint: Train as planned, one effort step harder.
phase__test_hint: One top set on the main lift, half the sets elsewhere.
phase__deload_hint: Half the sets, easier effort, lighter loads.
phase__week_hint: Change the phase for this week
phase__override_limit_hint: Set a changed week back to the pattern to change another
phase__inserted_hint: A deload week you added. Undo it from Train.
phase__week_body: Change this week's phase. The pattern stays as it is.
